verdict.rationale: Clerk documents several pieces that support automation without a browser. There is an official CLI (clerk init, impersonate, webhook relay, production deploy), personal access tokens for the Backend API, and a published OpenAPI spec. Agent registration can provision an accountless Clerk application and keys without an account. However, nothing documents running the CLI non-interactively or inside CI pipelines, so headless/CI operation is only implied by these pieces. Missing for 10: documented CI/non-interactive CLI mode (flags, env-var auth), CI pipeline guides or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
